meta.title: Lab-Grown Diamond Gifts Under €200 | I Want Jewels
meta.description: Find affordable lab-grown diamond jewellery gifts under €200. Compare earrings, necklaces, rings and bracelets by style, recipient and budget.

content.text: Looking for a special jewellery gift without spending more than €200? I Want Jewels has lab-grown diamond earrings, necklaces, rings and bracelets listed at €149 and €199. The pieces are made with 925 sterling silver, and you can choose a gift by the recipient’s style, the occasion and how often she is likely to wear it.

For an everyday gift, consider diamond studs or a simple pendant. For a more noticeable look, choose drop earrings or pavé hoops. If you know her ring size, a diamond ring can feel especially personal. Check the product page for the current price, finish and availability before ordering, as these details can change.

Quick answer: Good lab-grown diamond gifts under €200 include the Ottavia Studs at €149, Fiorella Necklace at €149, Pavé Hoops at €199 and Amadea Ring at €149. Choose earrings if you are unsure of her ring size; choose a ring when you know the size she wears.

sections.heading: Choose a Gift That Fits Her Style

content.text: For someone who wears jewellery every day
Choose a piece that is easy to wear with different outfits. Stud earrings and simple pendants are practical because they can suit both casual and smarter clothing.

The [Ottavia Studs](/products/iwjer0019), listed at €149, are one option for someone who wears earrings regularly. For a pendant, the [Aurora Singola Necklace](/products/iwjnk0004) is listed at €149 and has a solitaire design.
Browse more options in the [diamond earrings collection](/category/earrings) and [diamond necklaces collection](/category/necklaces).
For someone who prefers a statement look

If she likes jewellery that is more noticeable, look at drop earrings and larger hoop styles. The [Aurora Long Earrings](/products/iwjer0021) are listed at €149, while the [Pavé Hoops](/products/iwjer0005) are listed at €199.

Before choosing, consider whether she likes long earrings, hoops or designs that sit close to the earlobe. If you are unsure, check the [earrings collection](/category/earrings) for other shapes and styles.
For a romantic or meaningful present
A motif can give a gift extra meaning. The [Fiorella Necklace](/products/iwjnk0008), listed at €149, features a floral design that may suit someone who likes delicate, nature-inspired jewellery.

For a gift with a faith-related meaning, the [Amadea Necklace](/products/iwjnk0006) is listed at €199 and features a cross. Consider the recipient’s personal beliefs and taste before choosing symbolic jewellery.
For someone who loves rings
A ring can be a very personal gift, but the size needs to be right. The [Amadea Ring](/products/iwjrn0009) is listed at €149, and the [Attraverso Ring](/products/iwjrn0002) is listed at €199.

Check the available sizes on each product page before ordering. I Want Jewels also has a [ring size guide](/products/iwjrn0005) with a conversion chart. If you do not know her size, earrings or a necklace may be a simpler choice.
Explore more styles in the [diamond rings collection](/category/rings).
For someone who likes bracelets

A bracelet can be a thoughtful choice when you know she enjoys wearing jewellery on her wrist. The [Serafina Bracelet](/products/iwjbr0003) is listed at €149. Check its size and fastening details on the product page to make sure it is suitable.
See the full [bracelet collection](/category/bracelets) for other designs.

sections.heading: How to Choose Affordable Diamond Jewellery as a Gift

content.text: 1. Think about what she already wears
Look at whether she usually chooses studs, hoops, drops, pendants, rings or bracelets. A gift that fits her existing habits is more likely to become part of her regular rotation.
2. Check her preferred finish

I Want Jewels product pages show the available finish options for each piece. If you are buying a gift, notice whether she normally wears yellow, rose or white-toned jewellery and check which finishes are available for your chosen design.
3. Check sizing before buying a ring or bracelet
Ring size matters, and bracelet fit can also affect comfort. Confirm the sizes offered on the specific product page. If you cannot check the size discreetly, choose earrings or a necklace instead.
4. Choose the design for the occasion

A simple pair of studs or a solitaire pendant can work for birthdays and everyday gifting. Drop earrings or pavé hoops may feel more suited to an evening occasion. A symbolic design can mark a personal milestone when its meaning feels right for the recipient.
5. Confirm the product details

The product page is the best place to confirm the current price, material details, available finishes, sizes and availability. You can also review the website’s [frequently asked questions](/faq) for information about ordering and delivery.

sections.heading: Are Lab-Grown Diamonds a Good Gift?

content.text: Lab-grown diamonds are diamonds created in a laboratory rather than formed underground. I Want Jewels identifies the stones in these products as lab-grown diamonds. If the recipient wants diamond jewellery but you are working within a set budget, comparing the current styles and product details can help you find a suitable piece under €200.
The jewellery listed in the collections uses 925 sterling silver, with finish details shown on individual product pages. Check those details for the exact piece you are considering.
